study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Use normative modeling to quantify individual age-related deviations in functional (emotion-matching fMRI) and structural MRI in youths with disruptive behavior disorders, and integrate deviations across modalities via linked ICA to relate to aggression.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: The paper clearly states that participants were part of two EU-funded projects: Aggressotype and MATRICS. Data were collected across nine sites in Europe (five sites included in final fMRI analysis). These are the datasets used for both healthy controls and cases.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: Participants in the current study were part of the EU-funded Aggressotype and MATRICS projects. ... In total 208 participants (129 cases, 79 controls) aged 8-18 years were assessed using functional MRI (fMRI) and anatomical scans were acquired in n=248 (154 cases, 94 controls) across nine sites in Europe.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: DBD youths showed greater positive age-related deviations in amygdala during face processing; multimodal deviations (DMN, amygdala, striatum) related to aggression, and linked ICA explained ~23% variance in DBD phenotype.
